## Teaching points

1. Bony tenderness and inability to take four steps warrant ankle films. Check the medial side, skin and distal circulation.
2. A congruent mortise and an isolated distal fracture support stability; reassess if medial or proximal findings suggest a different pattern.
3. Give an explicit weight-bearing and support plan. Stable fractures may bear weight as tolerated; uncertain stability needs timely review.
4. Analgesia can improve comfort without making the fracture disappear. Check circulation and sensation after support is applied.
